title: One week on, here's the impact GTA 6's launch had on the industry so far
summary:
GTA 6 has been on sale for a week, and remained the dominant game and talking point across the games industry – supported, admittedly, by a quiet news week in America due to the Thanksgiving holiday. Beyond its record-breaking day-one revenue haul, it's now possible to start judging its impact on the wider industry, and consider if the anticipation – and in some cases, anxiety – was justified.

title: GTA 6's pirate PC ports: new tools, old problem | Opinion
summary:
I'm sorry in advance. I know we'd all far prefer to be spending our time running around the sun-soaked dystopia of Vice City this week rather than spending it reading yet another column about the game, but we need to talk about GTA 6 again. Specifically, we need to talk about the side story that's spun off from the game's launch – namely the scramble to get it running on PC, before Rockstar itself has so much as officially announced a PC version. It's a story that's getting an outsized amount of attention precisely because GTA 6 is involved, but the consequences of what's playing out will reach far beyond Rockstar or Take-Two.

Read more

title: "This was unlike anything else we've ever seen before" - but GTA 6's success is limited by the console install base, and its future rests on PC
summary:
That GTA 6 was going to be a hit was never in doubt, and the glowing reviews that arrived as the copies finally unlocked on the 18th ensured it. The scale of its success still managed to surprise, though: 32.5 million copies and revenue of $3.79b on the first day, surpassing all expectations. Analysts talking to GamesIndustry.biz have commended the game's unprecedented attach rate, but say that with the console install base limited, the currently-unconfirmed PC release is the chief scale opportunity.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 led US sales in October according to Circana, marking the 19th consecutive year a Call of Duty title has been the best-selling game during its launch month.

title: US Senate hearing examines child safety on Roblox, considers bipartisan bill to bypass forced arbitration
summary:
The US Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Crime and Counterterrorism held a hearing this week to examine child safety on Roblox and consider a bipartisan bill that would allow families and victims to bypass forced arbitration.

title: The future of British gaming is more than just games | Opinion
summary:
